world.name: Veridian Depths
world.concept: An underwater civilization where bioluminescent organisms serve as writing, architecture, and social hierarchy.
world.culture: Communal, slow-paced, deeply interconnected. Communication is visual/emotional through light patterns.
world.environment: Deep ocean trenches, bioluminescent coral cities, thermal vent power sources.
world.materials: Living coral, chitin, bioluminescent fluid, pressure-adapted glass, deep-sea minerals.
world.shape_language: Organic curves, branching structures, radial symmetry, flowing forms.
world.color: Deep blues, teals, bioluminescent greens, occasional warm bioluminescent orange.
world.light: Internal bioluminescence, thermal vent glow, filtered surface light.
world.technology: Bio-integrated, grown rather than built, symbiotic machinery.

visual_principles.architecture: Organic branching structures, no straight lines, bioluminescent navigation markers
visual_principles.characters: Flowing forms, bioluminescent patterns as identity, webbed extremities, large light-sensitive eyes
visual_principles.objects: Grown from living material, no sharp edges, functional beauty, symbiotic design
visual_principles.typography: Light patterns, not written symbols. Communication through bioluminescent sequences.
visual_principles.motion: Fluid, weighted by water pressure, graceful but deliberate.
